respStmt.resp: Digital reconstruction, TEI encoding, and witness collation
respStmt.name: University research project

sourceDesc.p: Manifest for the edition, witnesses, relations, authorities and bibliography.

encodingDesc.p: TEI P5 package. Reconstructed reference text and witness-specific reconstructions are encoded separately; critical apparatus remains traceable to De Michelis note numbers. Witness organization is not normalized to a single protocol numbering.

refsDecl.p: Apparatus locations use anchors with xml:id note-N in the reconstructed text; witness readings point to witnesses.xml.

revisionDesc.change: Release 1.0: consolidated GitHub Pages research package.
v5: all former scope-review cases adjudicated; nested apparatus syntax resolved; witness structures and paratext encoded; authority registers linked.
